<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then the first crate and the twenty seventh crate both read eigh.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check your own way, ask yourself two questions.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Does every crate get a label that no other crate has?
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Is there always a next label after any label you write?
<bookmark mark='m4'/>If both answers are yes, your way of labelling works.
